title: Normalized projective-bundle realization and chart data
statement: For a scheme $B$ [def-pc-scheme] and an $\mathcal O_B$-module $F$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], a normalized projective-bundle realization consists of the affine-basis symmetric graded algebra, its relative Proj [def-nagata-relative-proj], the degree-one twist [def-weil-pbc-proj-twisting-sheaf] glued with the homogeneous-localization restrictions, and its quotient from the pullback of $F$ [def-pc-module-pullback], fixed on degree-one generators. A frame chart identifies this realization over an open set with relative projective space [def-nagata-relative-projective-space] and the polynomial model, preserving the quotient sections, their free-generator property, and coordinate ratios. A base-change datum consists of coefficientwise PullbackData with its generator equation, canonical Proj map, and the twist isomorphism satisfying the quotient square. Coordinate geometry over a field records the coordinate hyperplane, affine complement, Cartier coordinate divisors, their dual ideals, and the reduced coordinate intersection. This node records the existing data definitions extracted with the frame-section composite factored through a named frame-vector map from the tautological-geometry module; it introduces no new version of any geometric notion.
